source: Real recording-control HWNDs plus moving synthetic BGRA video. Native display affinity, UI rendering, media encode/decode and lifecycle evidence; not a manual desktop recording or proof of GDI exclusion.
checks: Real recording boundary HWNDs at 100%/200% display scale match the exact capture pixels, including negative monitor origins; all four native edges exist, the center is hollow, activation/layered styles are absent, and WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE is retained.
Real recording HUD HWND is opaque (no WS_EX_LAYERED), accepts/readbacks WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE, enables Stop after startup and renders its timer/Stop fixture.
Real save/progress HWNDs accept/readback display affinity. Save dialog renders light/dark fixtures, restores Balanced and updates details for all three slider choices.

Six-second native soak encoded 167 frames using 1 distinct managed arrays; real Processed callbacks permitted reuse. Decoded source frames retained red/blue/green center colors across reuse, and repeated Stop finalized the MP4.
Small & fast: 1280×720, 15 fps, 37262 bytes, native frame decode passed.
Balanced: 1600×900, 24 fps, 66077 bytes, native frame decode passed.
High quality: 1600×900, 30 fps, 70084 bytes, native frame decode passed.
Early and active export cancellation preserved an existing file, removed staging files, and allowed a successful retry.

Three native sessions captured then aborted, tolerated repeated Abort/Dispose and late completion, and removed their temporary files. Capture failure and pre-start cancellation completed without a stranded buffer wait.
Temporary source directory removed after recording/export release their file handles.
